$comment: Tool contract for the bridge (server/bridge.ts). Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8787. Adapt to OpenClaw's tool/MCP registration at kickoff.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Current antenna geometry (mm) and the last simulation telemetry (S11 in dB, input impedance in ohms, resonant frequency in GHz).

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Apply one small geometry change, run a full-wave FDTD solve in the browser, and return the new telemetry. Edits smaller than the 0.5 mm grid have no effect and come back with a no_voxel_change warning.

reason.description: One line: why this edit. Logged for the demo, not applied.

inset_depth_mm.description: Depth of the inset feed notch. Deeper lowers the input resistance.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Reset to the mismatched baseline patch and re-solve.
